subject: pe
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: In an antagonistic pair, when the biceps contracts to flex the elbow, the triceps acts as the:
questions.explain: The triceps is the antagonist that relaxes and lengthens while the biceps (agonist) contracts.

questions.q: Which muscle straightens (extends) the leg at the knee?
questions.explain: The quadriceps extend the knee, working antagonistically with the hamstrings.

questions.q: Which structure separates the thoracic and abdominal cavities and is the main muscle of breathing?
questions.explain: The diaphragm is the dome-shaped muscle that contracts and flattens to draw air into the lungs.

questions.q: Which is an immediate (short-term) effect of exercise?
questions.explain: Breathing rate increases immediately during exercise to take in more oxygen and remove carbon dioxide.

questions.q: Standing on tiptoes (plantar flexion at the ankle) is an example of which class of lever?
questions.explain: Rising onto the toes is a second-class lever: the load is between the fulcrum (toes) and the effort (calf).

questions.q: Aerobic exercise is best described as exercise performed:
questions.explain: Aerobic means 'with oxygen' - energy is produced using oxygen during lower-intensity, longer-duration exercise.

questions.q: Which type of blood vessel carries blood away from the heart?
questions.explain: Arteries carry blood away from the heart, usually at high pressure.

questions.q: A biceps curl uses which class of lever, with the effort between the fulcrum and the load?
questions.explain: A biceps curl is a third-class lever: the effort (muscle) lies between the fulcrum (elbow) and the load (hand).

questions.q: Which of the following is a long-term effect of regular aerobic training on the heart?
questions.explain: Cardiac hypertrophy increases stroke volume, so the heart pumps more per beat and resting heart rate falls.

questions.q: Which joint type is found at the elbow and knee?
questions.explain: The elbow and knee are hinge joints allowing flexion and extension only.

questions.q: Where does gas exchange take place in the lungs?
questions.explain: Gas exchange occurs across the thin walls of the alveoli, where oxygen diffuses into the blood.

questions.q: Anaerobic exercise typically results in the build-up of:
questions.explain: Anaerobic exercise produces energy without oxygen, leading to lactic acid build-up.
